items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The transcript mentions 'Hayns' in the interviewer's question ('When was he born? Hayns: He was born...'), but the interviewee (Roy Haynes) does not mention or interact with anyone named 'Hayns'. The name 'Hayns' appears to be a transcription error or a reference to the interviewer/other speaker, no

ctx.x: Hayns: He was born – I forget their ages. He was born in the ’50s when I was with Sarah. He was born when I was with Sarah. I remember I got a – I was working in Washington, D.C., and his mother sent me a telegram.
